mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce discount rates for equity valuation.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC > -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.5% signals labor market weakness that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not negative in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO below 12-month moving average), a decline in industrial production predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In supply-constrained regimes (INDPRO < 12mo MA), SPX 60-day forward returns are not negative in > 60% of instances (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening housing market and broader economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST is above its 12-month average (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation rate above 2.5% signals an inflationary environment that triggers monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not negative in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a severe labor market contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), a further rise in the federal funds rate signals aggressive policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening regimes (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), SPX 60-day forward returns are not negative in > 60% of instances (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
